Case: Driver Sentiment Monitoring

THROO's driver community discusses pain points daily in Chinese-language WeChat groups. I scoped a PyWxDump + Claude aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) pipeline to turn that unstructured discussion into weekly reports for team meetings, Notion documentation, and executive briefings — tracking order volume, payout delays, dispatch bugs, and competitor benchmarking against Empower.

PROBLEM: unstructured driver feedback across WeChat→AI-ASSISTED WORKFLOW: PyWxDump + Claude ABSA pipeline→OUTPUT: weekly sentiment reports

03AI Theory
I understand the rationale behind AI, not just how to use AI tools.

Theory

MS coursework covering deep learning, CNNs, RNNs/LSTMs, reinforcement learning, and Transformers, alongside a Digital Marketplaces course connecting surge pricing theory, LP dispatch optimization, and backpressure dynamic pricing.

Understanding → Application

Applied surge pricing and dispatch optimization theory to THROO's competitive positioning against Uber and Lyft. Separately, ran a segmented deep learning study — GAF encoding with ResNet-50/AlexNet, plus a 1D-CNN ablation — on 171 resolved Polymarket contracts to test whether prediction markets are equally forecastable. Under a conditional evaluation framework, sports contracts reached r = 0.668 near resolution while crypto collapsed to r = 0.030 outside the dense mid-price region.
